channel.title: CNA's Blog
channel.description: Building a portable XNA-style framework for the long term.

item.title: Recreating Classic XNA Sample Techniques in Modern CNA
item.description: Rebuild useful techniques from publicly available XNA sample projects in CNA with clearer ownership, portable shaders, tests and modern build discipline.

item.title: Building an Island Simulator Feature from Start to Finish
item.description: Follow one Island Simulator feature from design and asset provenance through CNA content, world placement, interaction, audio, saves, tests and screenshots.

item.title: Building a Deferred Renderer with CNA
item.description: Assemble a CNA deferred-rendering demo with a documented G-buffer, light volumes, shadows, transparency, capability fallbacks and cross-renderer tests.

item.title: Building a Terrain Demo with CNA
item.description: Turn CNA terrain concepts into a shippable demo with generated geometry, fly camera, LOD, material layers, collision queries and renderer captures.

item.title: Building a Split-screen Racing Game with CNA
item.description: Build a CNA racing vertical slice with vehicle dynamics, checkpoints, chase cameras, split-screen rendering, controller ownership and performance gates.

item.title: Building a Small 2D Platformer with CNA
item.description: Assemble a compact CNA platformer vertical slice with fixed-step movement, tile collision, camera, animation, collectibles, UI, audio and tests.

item.title: Continuous Integration for CNA on Six Platforms
item.description: Design a CNA CI matrix for Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS and Web with reproducible dependencies, layered tests, renderer evidence and signed releases.

item.title: Downloadable Content and Live Content Updates
item.description: Deliver CNA content packs safely with signed manifests, resumable downloads, atomic activation, dependency resolution, rollback and save compatibility.

item.title: Voice Chat in a CNA Game
item.description: Integrate voice chat beside CNA with capture, encoding, jitter buffering, spatial playback, moderation, accessibility and strict privacy controls.

item.title: Securing an Authoritative CNA Game Server
item.description: Harden a headless CNA game service with strict protocol parsing, authenticated sessions, server-side validation, resource limits and privacy-aware operations.

item.title: Rollback Networking for CNA Games
item.description: Design rollback above CNA with deterministic fixed ticks, compact snapshots, delayed remote input, resimulation, confirmed effects and desynchronization diagnostics.

item.title: Client Prediction, Interpolation and Server Reconciliation
item.description: Extend a CNA multiplayer game with ticked commands, local prediction, authoritative reconciliation, remote interpolation and hostile-network tests.

item.title: Building an In-game Developer Console in CNA
item.description: Add a safe CNA developer console with typed commands, completion, history, structured output, permission boundaries and test automation.

item.title: Day, Night and Weather Systems in CNA
item.description: Coordinate CNA lighting, sky, fog, particles, audio and gameplay through a deterministic world-time and weather state model with scalable rendering tiers.

item.title: Navigation, Pathfinding and Steering in CNA Games
item.description: Add navigation above CNA with grids or navmeshes, deterministic A-star, asynchronous requests, path following, local avoidance and visual diagnostics.

item.title: Procedural Generation with Reproducible Seeds
item.description: Build deterministic procedural worlds above CNA with named random streams, staged constraints, versioned recipes, validation and compact saves.

item.title: Data-driven Scenes and Prefabs in CNA
item.description: Build versioned scene and prefab data above CNA with stable IDs, explicit overrides, dependency validation, streaming and safe runtime publication.

item.title: Building a Particle Editor for CNA
item.description: Turn CNA particle code into an authoring workflow with versioned emitter assets, deterministic preview, curves, gradients, budgets and safe live reload.

item.title: Animation Blending, State Machines and Root Motion in CNA
item.description: Extend CNA model skinning with game-owned animation sampling, blend trees, state machines, events, root motion and deterministic tests.

item.title: Cameras for Real Games: Follow, Orbit, Shake and Split-screen
item.description: Turn CNA camera math into production camera rigs with follow damping, orbit input, collision, shake, transitions and per-viewport policy.

item.title: Character Controllers and Movement in CNA Games
item.description: Build a deterministic kinematic character controller above CNA with input-relative motion, sweeps, slopes, steps, moving platforms and diagnostic tests.

item.title: CPU–GPU Synchronization and Hidden Rendering Stalls
item.description: Find CNA rendering stalls caused by readback, dynamic resource reuse, queries, screenshots and queue saturation without relying on misleading CPU timings.

item.title: Frame Pacing, Input Latency and Present Modes in CNA
item.description: Diagnose smoothness beyond average FPS by measuring CNA frame pacing, queueing, presentation, input age and capability-dependent display policy.

item.title: Memory Management and Allocation-free Frames in CNA
item.description: Control frame-time variance in CNA games with ownership, reusable storage, frame arenas, pools, budgets and evidence-driven allocation diagnostics.

item.title: Hot-reloading Shaders and Game Content in CNA
item.description: Add transactional hot reload above CNA content with dependency tracking, thread-safe preparation, graphics-thread publication and failure-safe rollback.

item.title: Designing a Material System Above CNA Effects
item.description: Build a thin material layer over CNA effects that owns parameters, render state, variants, fallbacks, caching and diagnostics without hiding the framework.

item.title: Transparency, Alpha Testing and Draw Order in CNA
item.description: Make CNA transparency predictable with correct alpha conventions, depth policy, sorting, cutouts, particles and cross-renderer fixtures.

item.title: Stencil Buffer Techniques in CNA
item.description: Use CNA depth-stencil state deliberately for outlines, mirrors, portals, masks and bounded multi-pass effects across renderers.

item.title: Water Rendering in CNA
item.description: Build portable CNA water from a simple transparent surface through reflection, refraction, depth color, Fresnel response and scalable fallbacks.

item.title: Terrain Rendering in CNA
item.description: Build a scalable terrain layer above CNA with height data, chunk meshes, normals, LOD, materials, streaming, collision and cross-renderer tests.
